title: refactor(cli): clean up profile selector logic and remove legacy config

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue identifies existing technical debt in packages/cli/src/config/config.ts regarding legacy profileSelector logic and TODO comment. It provides clear context and actionable request to clean up legacy config initialization.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The change involves localized logic cleanup in packages/cli/src/config/config.ts to remove the legacy profileSelector branching logic and unused experimental properties, along with updating corresponding configuration tests.

summary.problem: Lingering technical debt in CLI configuration initialization related to legacy profileSelector logic.
summary.root_cause: Legacy profile selection logic (profileSelector) and TODO comments remain in packages/cli/src/config/config.ts, creating redundant conditional checks during config initialization.
summary.context: The profileSelector variable in packages/cli/src/config/config.ts sets context management flags based on experimental settings (stressTestProfile, powerUserProfile, generalistProfile, contextManagement) and passes experimentalContextManagementConfig to Config.

steps: Locate the profileSelector logic and legacy TODO comment in packages/cli/src/config/config.ts.
Remove the profileSelector conditional branching and legacy mapping logic.
Update the contextManagement property initialization and Config constructor parameters to directly determine enablement without relying on legacy profileSelector.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: CLI configuration initializes cleanly without legacy profileSelector logic, maintaining correct context management settings.
verification_steps: Run unit tests in packages/cli/src/config/config.test.ts to ensure config initialization works properly.
Add or update test cases verifying that Config options and experimental context settings load as expected.
